intro.title: Simple Todo List
intro.body: In this lesson, you will build a simple todo list application using React. You will learn how to manage a list of tasks using React state, allowing you to add new items and mark them as complete. The core programming concepts covered include handling user input with event handlers and updating the UI dynamically based on state changes. You will work with key React constructs like the useState hook, JSX for rendering, and event handling in a functional component. By the end, you will have a working interactive todo list that demonstrates fundamental React patterns.
intro.usecase: Todo lists are foundational UI patterns found in countless real-world applications. You'll see similar interfaces in project management tools like Trello or Asana for tracking tasks, in e-commerce sites for managing shopping carts, and in content management systems for handling draft articles or pending reviews. As a developer, you'll frequently build interfaces where users need to add, view, and remove items - whether it's managing user accounts in admin panels, curating playlists in music apps, or organizing filters in data dashboards. Mastering this pattern gives you the skills to create interactive lists that are central to modern web applications.
